headlines.description: — After never even having a lead in Cleveland, the Orlando Magic came back with the biggest postseason victory ever over the Cavaliers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Magic hand Cavaliers worst playoff loss in franchise history, win 121-83 to cut their deficit to 2-1

headlines.description: — Joel Embiid is suffering from Bell's palsy and played Game 3 with a bulky knee brace to sturdy the 7-footer after dealing with injuries...
headlines.shortLinkText: Joel Embiid scores 50 points to lead 76ers past Knicks 125-114 to cut deficit to 2-1

events.name: Denver Nuggets at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — With one championship ring and a tenacious veteran core, the Denver Nuggets are a daunting matchup for any opponent in the NBA.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon, Jokic lead the Nuggets to the brink of a sweep with a 112-105 win over the Lakers in Game 3
